name: temple_of_enlightenment_scry_1_to_the_bottom
notes: Pa628282112 G4. Printed: 'This land enters tapped. When this land enters, scry 1.' Seat 0 plays the Temple as its land drop and answers 'bottom' to the scry: exactly its own top card (Library 5) moves to the bottom of its own library; seat 1's library is untouched; the Temple is tapped.
